scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
50 Jellopies and 20,000 zeny are all you need to get special effect on your green onion or carrot!
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
50個傑勒比結晶和20,000 Zeny，就能給你的大蔥或胡蘿蔔附加特殊效果！

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
Enchant and reset have ^ff000030% of failure.^000000 Invest in your veggie and luck!
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
附魔和重置都有^ff000030%的失敗率^000000。投資你的蔬菜和運氣吧！

scripts.text: How much do I need to enchant?
scripts.translation: 附魔需要多少錢？

scripts.text: Enchant to Poring Village Veggie
scripts.translation: 附魔波利村蔬菜

scripts.text: Reset Poring Village Veggie
scripts.translation: 重置波利村蔬菜

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
As I heard, you can get Poring Village Green Onion or Carrot if you go west a bit more from here.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
我聽說，從這裡再往西走一點，就能找到波利村的大蔥或胡蘿蔔。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
I do enchant to the fresh vegetable.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
我對新鮮的蔬菜進行附魔。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
Enchant or Reset requires 20,000z and 50 Jellopy! It's not bad, is it?
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
附魔或重置需要20,000 Zeny和50個傑勒比結晶！這價格不貴吧？

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
Well... As you know, it's a vegetable any way. So sometimes it can be broken.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
嗯...你知道的，畢竟它只是蔬菜。所以有時候會壞掉。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
Please put on the equipment you'd like to enchant first.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
請先裝備好你要附魔的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
This is not a vegetable!?
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
這不是蔬菜！？

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
This vegetable cannot be enchanted anymore.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
這個蔬菜無法再附魔了。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
This enchant requires 50 Jellopy and 20,000z..... But... you don't have them.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
這次附魔需要50個傑勒比結晶和20,000 Zeny...但是...你沒有。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
Tada! Enchant is done! Check your vegetable.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
看！附魔完成了！檢查一下你的蔬菜吧。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
It must have been a rotten vegetable. It's a shame that I can't stand this level of power...
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
那一定是個腐朽的蔬菜。真遺憾，我承受不了這麼強的力量...

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
Please put on the equipment you'd like to enchant first.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
請先裝備好你要附魔的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
This is not a vegetable!?
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
這不是蔬菜！？

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
This is a vegetable that has never been fortified...
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
這是一顆從未被強化的蔬菜...

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
This enchant requires 50 Jellopy and 20,000z..... But... you don't have them.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
這次附魔需要50個傑勒比結晶和20,000 Zeny...但是...你沒有。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
The item is complete! Check it out.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
物品完成了！看看效果吧。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
It must have been a rotten vegetable. It's a shame that I can't stand this level of power...
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔師]
那一定是個腐朽的蔬菜。真遺憾，我承受不了這麼強的力量...

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Wow~ You look like a novice. I do want to adventure with you someday when you grow up!
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
哇~你看起來像個初心者。等你長大一點，我很想和你一起冒險！

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Oh, now you are stronger than me. How did you grow so fast?
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
哦，現在你比我強了。你怎麼長得這麼快？

scripts.text:
[Emily]
I should find another adventurer who is similar with my level. It's been nice knowing you.
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
我應該找個和我等級差不多的冒險者。很高興認識你。

scripts.text:
[Emily]
My name is Emily. I was waiting for someone who will go on adventures with me!
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
我叫艾米麗。我一直在等一個願意和我一起冒險的人！

scripts.text: Who said I will adventure with you?
scripts.translation: 誰說要和你一起冒險了？

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Well, come one. Don't be stern. Listen, you can decide after listening to my story. Of course, I can give you a proper reward.
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
哎呀，別這麼嚴肅嘛。聽我說，聽完我的故事你再決定也不遲。當然，我會給你一份像樣的報酬。

scripts.text: Proper Reward?
scripts.translation: 像樣的報酬？

scripts.text: I'm not interested.
scripts.translation: 我不感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Emily]
How square! It's much better to be together!
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
真無趣！在一起冒險不是更好嗎！

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Yes! Proper Reward.
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
對！像樣的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Emily]
It seems this Poring Village can be defeated by beginners just like us. It's just a wild guess though...
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
看來這個波利村對我們這種初學者來說也能輕鬆搞定。當然，這只是我的猜測...

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Well, actually I cannot give you the reward officially through adventurer association. But we can separate the income after hunting.
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
嗯，其實我不能通過冒險者協會正式支付報酬。不過我們可以打完怪後分賬。

scripts.text: But 50-50 sounds fair to me.
scripts.translation: 不過五五分成聽起來挺公平的。

scripts.text:
[Emily]
No way. 70-30. And I'm 70 of course.
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
沒門。七三分。當然，我拿七成。

scripts.text: It's gotta be 50-50 or it's no good
scripts.translation: 必須是五五分成，否則免談

scripts.text:
[Emily]
How about 60-40!!
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
那...六四分成！！
五五分成...

scripts.text:
[Emily]
This drives me crazy. OK, 50-50. Let's go with this.
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
真是拿你沒辦法。好吧，五五分成。就這麼定了。

scripts.translation: ^ff0000在副本內進行的怪物馴服等處理，將不被視為正常進度。請注意。^000000

scripts.text:
[Emily]
So, are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
那麼，你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Emily]
You look very tired.
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
你看起來很累。

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Why don't you come back after a while? Take a break for now.
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
不如你先休息一下，過一會兒再回來吧。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Any processing of monsters such as monster taming inside the dungeon will not be considered a normal progress. Please note that.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000在副本內進行的怪物馴服等處理，將不被視為正常進度。請注意。^000000

scripts.text:
[Emily]
So, are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
那麼，你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: ^0000ffAll Traces of the Poring Village quest were removed. Now, talk to Emily again to enter^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff“波利村”任務的所有痕跡已被清除。現在，請再次與艾米麗對話以進入。^000000

scripts.translation: ^ff0000在副本內進行的怪物馴服等處理，將不被視為正常進度。請注意。^000000

scripts.text: ^ff0000In beginner mode, the player transforms into a monster. Please note that the existing transformation effect disappears when entering and proceeding.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000在初學者模式中，玩家會變形為魔物。請注意，進入並繼續遊戲時，現有的變形效果將會消失。^000000

scripts.text:
[Emily]
So, are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
那麼，你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Hmm you should create a party first to start this grand adventure.
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
嗯，你應該先建立一個隊伍，才能開始這場偉大的冒險。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Now I'm looking for the entrance, please talk to me again after it's totally open.
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
現在我在尋找入口，等它完全開啟後，請再和我說話。

scripts.text: An unknown error occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生了一個未知錯誤。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Time's crack is not created yet.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000時間的裂縫尚未生成。^000000

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Let's go forward.
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
讓我們前進吧。

scripts.text:
[Emily]
I'm going to start slowly now...
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
我現在要慢慢開始了...

scripts.text:
[Emily]
You can have all of the items you find in this dungeon. I already have some.
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
在這個副本里找到的所有物品都可以歸你所有。我已經有一些了。

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Ah, I found some items. Let me give you one of them. Just to celebrate your first visit!
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
啊，我找到了一些物品。讓我給你其中一個吧。就當是慶祝你的首次訪問！

scripts.text:
[Emily]
I don't need this novice box. You can take it. Now, let's go out side!
scripts.translation:
[艾米麗]
我不需要這個初心者盒子。你可以拿走它。現在，讓我們出去吧！
